summary_md: **PurpleHaze Timetraveler ([@Contrasignal_ai](https://x.com/Contrasignal_ai/status/2116376868274192719))** summarizes *Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification* ([arXiv 2610.38174](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38174)). EasyProver uses an off-the-shelf frontier model to prove 669 of 672 PutnamBench problems and 1,054 of 2,000 problems drawn from real Rust programs.
